parameters.name: should_texture

parameters.name: enable_rigging
parameters.description: Auto-rig the resulting mesh with a humanoid skeleton. Works best on humanoid/character subjects; non-bipeds (animals, objects) may rig poorly. Adds cost.

parameters.name: enable_animation
parameters.description: Apply a pre-canned animation clip to the rig. Requires enable_rigging=true. Pick the clip via animation_action_id. Adds cost.

parameters.name: should_remesh
parameters.description: Re-topologize the mesh (default true). When false, returns the raw triangular mesh and topology/target_polycount are ignored.

parameters.name: texture_prompt
parameters.description: Text prompt to guide texturing. Requires should_texture=true.

parameters.name: texture_image_url
parameters.description: Reference image URL for texture style transfer. Requires should_texture=true.

parameters.name: target_polycount
parameters.description: Target triangle count, 100-300000 (default 30000). Higher = more detail, larger file.

parameters.name: topology
parameters.description: Mesh topology: 'quad' for smooth/editable surfaces, 'triangle' (default) for detailed geometry.

parameters.name: symmetry_mode
parameters.description: Symmetry during generation: 'auto' (default) detects it, 'on' enforces it, 'off' disables it.

parameters.name: enable_pbr
parameters.description: Generate PBR material maps (metallic, roughness, normal) in addition to base color. Requires should_texture=true.

parameters.name: pose_mode
parameters.description: Generate the character in a canonical rig-friendly pose ('a-pose' or 't-pose'). Omit for no specific pose. Recommended with enable_rigging for cleaner skeletons.

parameters.name: rigging_height_meters
parameters.description: Approximate real-world character height in meters (default 1.7). Only used when enable_rigging=true.

parameters.name: animation_action_id
parameters.description: Animation clip id (integer, 0-696) for the rig. Required when enable_animation=true. Common picks - idle: 0; walk: 30 (Casual_Walk); run: 16 (RunFast); jump: 466 (Regular_Jump); wave: 28 (Big_Wave_Hello); dance: 64 (All_Night_Dance). For anything else, call the animation_actions tool to search the full 678-action library by name or category.

modelos.name: Ad Multiplier Recreate
modelos.description: Recreate a 4-30 second source ad as a new ad for another audience, language, product, cast or setting, keeping its structure, beats and pacing, or regenerate only its hook, its CTA or both and stitch them back into the source. Everything is decided from the video, the images and the prompt: the backend analyzes the source, classifies the images and writes the generation prompt.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution: 480p, 720p, or 1080p.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: recreate renders the whole ad again and costs the source length rounded up. sections renders a new hook (4-15 s), CTA (4-5 s) or both, each in its own render, and stitches them in place of the source ones; the rest of the source is kept as is. The run reserves the longest lengths and is charged for the lengths it renders. With both, if one part fails the other is still delivered with the source kept in place of the failed one, and only the delivered part is charged. If the source has no clear hook or CTA, the new one is added before (hook) or after (CTA) the whole source instead.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: With mode sections, which part to regenerate: hook (the opening), cta (the closing call to action) or both. Omit it for recreate.
